student_learning_goal: I can model a real-life situation from my own life.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can model a real-life situation from my own life.
header.character_watermark: Maple and Sap Sam together in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall combined).

parts.student_instructions: Pick a real-life topic. Draw or write 1 sentence describing the situation.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. A topic title slot and description box.

image_placeholders.description: A topic title slot 'My Topic: ___' with a 2-line description box and a small drawing area in B&W line-art, ~7in x 1.5in. Header 'Part 1: Situation'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P1_TOPIC: keywords (topic, situation) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Should describe a real-life situation from the child's life.

parts.student_instructions: Write a math question about your situation. Use HOW MANY, HOW MUCH, HOW LONG, or HOW TALL.

image_placeholders.description: A long question slot in B&W line-art, ~7in x 1in. Header 'Part 2: Math Question'. One long line: 'My question: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P2_QUESTION: keywords (math, question) name what the slot asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Must be countable or measurable about the topic.

parts.student_instructions: Collect or imagine data. Draw a tally, table, or picture.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. A data area with grid space.

image_placeholders.description: A data collection area in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2in. Header 'Part 3: Data'. Includes a small tally box on the left and blank space for tables or drawings on the right.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P3_DATA: keywords (data, tally) name what the area asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Should show a tally, table, or counted data.

parts.student_instructions: Use your data to predict an answer to your question.

image_placeholders.description: A prediction slot in B&W line-art, ~7in x 1in. Header 'Part 4: Prediction'. One long line: 'My prediction: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P4_PREDICTION: keywords (my, prediction) name what the slot asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Should be supported by the data from Part 3.

parts.student_instructions: Would your model need refining? Draw or write your reflection.

image_placeholders.description: A reflection box in B&W line-art, ~7in x 1.5in, with 2 lines and a small drawing space. Header 'Part 5: Reflection'. Lines: 'My model needs refining because: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P5_REFLECT: keywords (my, reflection) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Should include a refinement or reasoning about model accuracy.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, swap with a partner and read each other's models. Tell them ONE thing you liked.
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone summative worksheet. Use as integrated C4 evidence across all 5 modelling steps. Watch for choice paralysis — provide situation cards as starters.
